CommunityApplications.Profile: Maintained by GitHub developer marco-taylor, this repository provides Nemotron Unified Wyoming, a German CPU-based speech-to-text server for Home Assistant and Unraid using the Wyoming protocol. Missing L37 models are downloaded from a versioned GitHub model release and verified with pinned SHA256 checksums. NVIDIA trained the original model; this project provides an ONNX adaptation under OpenMDW-1.1. Project documentation and support through GitHub Issues are available from the project page.
